tagline: NONPROFIT CFO  ·  GRANTS & GOVERNMENT CONTRACTS  ·  ERP & SALESFORCE  ·  BOARD REPORTING
profile: Nonprofit finance executive who pairs public-sector contract expertise with modern financial systems. Leads financial policy, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance; directs audit readiness under GAAP and Uniform Guidance; and has overseen billing and compliance for New York City agency contracts. Implemented ERP and CRM platforms, including Salesforce, and renegotiated vendor contracts to cut costs 35%. Held P&L accountability for an $8M portfolio and a 140-person division within a $50M+ nonprofit, turning a $1M deficit into a 13% surplus. Presents financial analysis clearly to Boards and Finance Committees and advises executive teams on financial and risk matters.

bullets.text: Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Structured the financial framework for a NYPA Clean Energy Workforce Program, aligning public funding, compliance, and performance metrics.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Partnered with the CEO and Board on long-range planning, risk management, and organizational growth strategy.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Held full P&L accountability for an $8M portfolio within a $50M+ nonprofit; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.
Developed revenue-generating social ventures that combined financial sustainability with mission outcomes.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Selected, implemented, and trained teams on CRM and business systems, including Salesforce, Zoho, Looker, SQL, and ERP platforms.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
